svg.title: Modeled Kafka consumer-group rebalance cascade
svg.desc: Buildopsy scenario diagram: a classic-eager Kafka group with 120 members and 40,000 partitions. The model assumes a 660-second pause and a 60,000-events-per-second arrival rate, yielding 39.6 million backlog events. Two retries plus one original request make three attempts per affected call. No company incident or telemetry is described.
svg.text: When rejoin cadence meets the eager-rebalance barrier
Illustrative inputs: 120 members · 40,000 partitions · 60,000 arriving events/s
1 original + 2 retries = 3 attempts per affected call, not 6× total load
Protocol: Apache Kafka documentation and KIP-429 · group size, pause and arrival rate are modeled inputs.
